ASK_QE_ME_DASH_BOARD_STATUS_Q: SELECT period_name, close_type, comments FROM ARFINRO.ASK_QE_ME_DASH_BOARD_STATUS
REVENUE_CONTROLS_Q: SELECT OU_NAME,Transaction_type,sum(LINE_AMOUNT_TRXN_CURR) Amount ,'Records Stuck With Error' Comments FROM ARFINRO.XXCFIR_REV_MONITORING_AR WHERE comments IS NOT NULL group by OU_NAME,Transaction_type order by OU_NAME
PERIOD_AND_QUARTER_Q: SELECT Period_name, 'Q' || quarter_num || 'FY' || period_year "QUARTER" FROM gl_periods WHERE period_set_name = 'Fiscal Year' AND SYSDATE - 15 BETWEEN start_date AND end_date + 1
CLOSE_START_END_TIME_Q: select CLOSE_TYPE, CLOSE_START_TIME, CLOSE_END_TIME, a.* from arfinro.ASK_QE_ME_INTERFACE_LOAD a where 1=1 and period_name='APR-23' and line_type = 'PRODUCT'
CLOSE_VOLUME_Q: SELECT line_type, line_count FROM arfinro.ASK_QE_ME_INTERFACE_LOAD WHERE period_name = 'APR-23' AND close_type = 'PRECLOSE'
CLOSE_ME_STATUS_Q: SELECT close_type, decode(b.short_code, 'AU', 'Australia', 'BR', 'Brazil', 'CA', 'Canada', 'CN', 'China', 'DE', 'Germany', 'IN', 'India', 'IT', 'Italy', 'JP', 'Japan', 'KR', 'South Korea', 'MX', 'Mexico', 'NL', 'Netherlands', 'PY', 'China Panyu', 'RU', 'Russia', 'ZA', 'South Africa', 'GB', 'United Kingdom', 'US', 'America', 'CISCO BSFT', 'BROADSOFT') operating_unit, period_name, close_status, steps_completed, category FROM arfinro.ask_qe_me_close_status a, hr_operating_units b WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.operating_unit = b.name AND period_name = 'MAY-23'
CLOSE_INVOICE_STATS_Q: select close_type, period_name,Invoice_count,PRODUCT_AMOUNT,SERVICE_AMOUNT,TAX_AMOUNT,USD_AMOUNT TOTAL_INVOICE_AMOUNT from arfinro.ASK_QE_ME_INVOICE_STATS where enabled_flag = 'Y' order by period_year, period_num
CLOSE_INTERFACE_LOAD_Q: select close_type, period_name,line_type,line_count,MOM_PERCENTAGE,PQM_PERCENTAGE,QOQ_PERCENTAGE,YOY_PERCENTAGE from ARFINRO.ASK_QE_ME_INTERFACE_LOAD WHERE enabled_flag = 'Y' ORDER BY period_year, quarter,period_num
CLOSE_QE_CASH_COLLECTED_Q: SELECT quarter, Period_name, wd_5, wd_4, wd_3, wd_2, wd_1, wd_0, total, status FROM ARFINRO.ASK_QE_ME_CASH_COLLECTED WHERE active_flag = 'Y'
TSV_TOP_SKU_EXC_QUERY: select transaction_id, subscription_ref_id, unique_id, transaction_source, transaction_type, inventory_item_id, item_name, element_type, amount, attribute8, comments from ARFINRO.XXCFIR_REV_MONITORING_NONAR where rownum<= 100
TSV_SUB_SKU_EXC_QUERY: select transaction_id, subscription_ref_id, unique_id, transaction_source, transaction_type, inventory_item_id, element_type, amount, attribute8, comments from ARFINRO.XXCFIR_REV_MONITORING_NONAR_SUB where rownum<= 100
STANDARD_AR_EXC_QUERY: SELECT period_name, period_year, quarter, ou_name, creation_date, trx_number, customer_trx_id, customer_trx_line_id, batch_source, transaction_type, trx_name, inventory_item_id, item_rev_account, item_catalog, org_id, ledger_id, currency_code, line_amount_trxn_curr, oa_flag, tsv_flag, meraki_flag, rev_account, unearn_account, sla_transferred, original_line_ref, original_oa_flag, original_tsv_flag, original_meraki_flag, original_rev_account, original_unearn_account, comments FROM arfinro.xxcfir_rev_monitoring_ar where rownum<= 100 order by creation_date
